description: SANDBOX ONLY. Simulate a deposit into a payment route so you can watch the conversion and payout complete without real money: a fiat deposit for an on-ramp or fiat-to-fiat route, or the route's USDT/USDC arriving on its address for an off-ramp (crypto_to_fiat) or swap (crypto_to_crypto) route. Fails on production.

amount.description: Deposit amount in major units of the route's source currency (e.g. '500.00')

externalDepositId.description: Your own reference for this deposit

scenario.description: 'completed' runs the deposit through to payout, 'failed' exercises the failure path, 'create_only' stops at the deposit. Off-ramp routes take 'completed' only

senderName.description: Name to attribute the deposit to (fiat routes)

senderReference.description: Payment reference on the deposit; for an off-ramp or swap route, the sending wallet address

name: simulate_route_deposit
title: Simulate payment route deposit (sandbox)
